label: Sec. 03  How Selection Works
title: Public
Programme
Starts 01.2027
intro: Intake will remain open throughout the year, with proposals reviewed and decisions made each quarter.

steps.title: One Intake
steps.description: Creators describe the work they want to make and the kind of support they need through a single intake form.

steps.title: Quarterly Review
steps.description: At the end of each quarter, direct grant decisions are made and selected larger proposals are advanced for further development.

steps.title: Matched Pathway
steps.description: Each submission is considered for a direct cultural grant or support developing a larger external funding proposal.
